package svc

import (
	"net/http"

	boenghttp "obs-brutal/boeng/http"
)

var GetUser = boenghttp.Wrap("get_user", func(w http.ResponseWriter, r *http.Request) {
	id := r.URL.Query().Get("id")
	user, err := repo.Find(r.Context(), id)
	if err != nil {
		http.Error(w, err.Error(), http.StatusInternalServerError)
		return
	}
	_ = renderJSON(w, user)
})
